subject: Payments routing & VAT reconciliation setup for Brightwave Health
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing & VAT — where should we expect invoices (portal vs email)?

Hi Sofia,

Quick question as we move to confirm the onboarding details: what's Redwood's preferred invoice delivery mechanism for enterprise accounts? Our AP team prefers getting PDFs via email, but we also see value in a vendor portal so we can pull consolidated statements.

A few specifics from our side:
- PO: BW-7789 (assigned to this engagement)
- VAT / tax: US entity with EU subsidiary — we'll need the VAT number on invoices when applicable
- Payment terms: usually Net30, but happy to confirm after we see the invoice format

Can you confirm if you can: (a) deliver a consolidated monthly invoice for multiple subscriptions, (b) provide e-invoice fields that map to our accounting system, and (c) add our AP mailbox as a portal user if we go that route?

If it's easier, loop in your billing team and we can share the AP contact and bank remittance details.

Thanks — looking to close the loop this week so treasury can schedule the first payment.

Best,
Daniel Cho
Head of Finance Operations
Brightwave Health
[Attachment: PO_BW-7789.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing & VAT — where should we expect invoices (portal vs email)?

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear summary and the PO. Happy to outline options and next steps so we can get your finance team set up this week.

Short answers up front:
- We can do a consolidated monthly invoice across subscriptions (single invoice per month with line-item detail).
- We support both: (1) automatic PDF invoice delivery via email to your AP mailbox, and (2) portal access for statements, invoice history, and downloadable XML/CSV exports.
- We can add ap@brightwavehealth.com as a portal user with read-only billing access, or as an AP admin if you want edit/mapping rights.

Action items I can take now:
1) Share our Billing Setup form so you can indicate preferred delivery channel and remittance contact.
2) Loop in our billing team to supply the invoice template and mapable fields for e-invoice.
3) Confirm VAT display options (we can show VAT number on-line items or on the header depending on your accounting needs).

I attached the short billing-setup-form — if you fill that and return it, Marissa (cc'd) will pick up the mapping and finalize the email/portal configuration. Also confirm the remit-to (ACH/SEPA/wire) preference and whether Net30 is acceptable. If you need Net45 or vendor-specific terms, note that here and we'll route to Sales Ops for approval.

Thanks — I copied Marissa and Vanessa to handle the mapping and the portal provisioning.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing-setup-form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightwavehealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing & VAT — delivery fields and sample invoice export

Hi Daniel — Marissa from Redwood Finance here. Thanks for the PO and context. A couple notes and a request for the AP team so we can finalize mapping quickly: 

What we can provide today:
- Sample invoice exports: CSV, XML, and PDF (CSV attached — Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv).
- Consolidated monthly invoice with line items grouped by subscription ID and project tags. 
- VAT handling: we will include the VAT number you provide and flag reverse-charge fields for EU transactions when applicable.

What I need from you to finish setup:
1) Confirm preferred delivery method: portal only, email only, or both (we recommend both for redundancy).
2) AP contact (name + email) for receipting and automated delivery (we'll add this address to the delivery list).
3) Remittance details needed on the invoice (ACH vs wire; for wire we'll include bank name, account number, and SWIFT).

If you want e-invoicing integration, tell me which fields your ERP needs (we can do custom field mapping for major ERPs). For most customers, mapping the following is sufficient: invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, po_number, line_description, charge_amount, tax_amount, vat_number, remit_to.

I'll hold off provisioning portal access until I get the AP mailbox and confirmation on delivery method. If you confirm both, I'll schedule portal invite and start automated emails to your AP address on the next invoice cycle (first invoice will be dated for the month of July).

Thanks — attaching the CSV template now.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv (CSV)]

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing & VAT — delivery fields and sample invoice export

Marissa / Sofia — thanks, this all looks good. Answers below and I've attached the PO for reference.

1) Delivery method: Portal + email copies to AP (ap@brightwavehealth.com). Portal is preferred for our reconciliations, but we need automated PDFs emailed for our payables queue.
2) AP contact: Michelle Park <ap@brightwavehealth.com> (team mailbox).
3) Remittance: ACH preferred for US payments — please include bank name, routing, and account last four for remittance instructions on the invoice.
4) VAT: Our EU subsidiary VAT is EU123456789 — please include that on any EU-domiciled invoices. For US-domiciled charges, no VAT applies.
5) Payment terms: Net30 is fine for the initial invoice.

We'd like the first invoice for July to be consolidated for all subscriptions and to reference PO BW-7789. Once you provision portal access, confirm the username/email used for the invite and we'll accept.

Thanks — attaching the PO.

Best,
Daniel Cho
Head of Finance Operations
Brightwave Health
[Attachment: PO_BW-7789.pdf (PDF)]
